# Access and eligibility ## Q1: How can I determine if my ad account has access to Upgrade Smart+ Campaigns (the Upgraded Smart+ experience)? A: To check your access, [log in to your TikTok Ads Manager account](https://ads.tiktok.com/i18n/login) and navigate to the campaign creation page. If you see a notification stating that Manual and Smart+ campaigns have been consolidated into a single workflow when App promotion, Lead generation, or Sales is selected as the advertising objective, then your ad account has access to Upgrade Smart+ Campaigns. Conversely, if the notification is absent and you have the options for **Manual campaign** and **Smart+ campaign** or just **Manual campaign** available for selection, it indicates that your ad account does not have access to Upgrade Smart+ Campaigns. The following table illustrates the different Ads Manager UIs for different scenarios.

# Differentiation between campaign types ## Q1: How do I differentiate between Upgrade Smart+, Smart+, and Manual Campaigns? A: You can retrieve all three campaign types using [/campaign/get/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1739315828649986) and identify each campaign type through the `campaign_automation_type` response parameter. The following table outlines the differences:
Campaign Type campaign_automation_type Value Example Campaign on Ads Manager UI Sample Response from /campaign/get/
Upgrade Smart+ Campaign UPGRADED_SMART_PLUS Upgrade Smart+ Campaigns display a Smart+ icon and lack the Smart+ Campaign setting when edited. See sample response below
Smart+ Campaign SMART_PLUS Smart+ Campaigns also display a Smart+ icon, but the Smart+ Campaign setting is toggled on when edited. See sample response below
Manual Campaign MANUAL Manual Campaigns do not display a Smart+ icon, and the Smart+ Campaign setting is toggled off when edited. See sample response below

within Ads Manager: # Data retrieval and API issues ## Q1: Why is the `ad_name` returned from `/ad/get/` for my Upgraded Smart+ Ad matching the creative name? A: This discrepancy may occur because you created Upgraded Smart+ Ads but did not apply the `ad_ids_v2` filter while using [/ad/get/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1735735588640770). Without this filter, you're receiving creative-level data, leading to the `ad_name` returned from `/ad/get/` reflecting the creative name rather than the ad name. To fetch ad-level data specific to Upgraded Smart+ Ads, you need to include the IDs of these ads in the filter. By doing so, the `ad_name` returned will accurately represent the ad name. Alternatively, consider using the [/smart_plus/ad/get/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1843317378982914) endpoint for detailed ad-level data retrieval. The following table summarizes the ad or creative data available for Upgraded Smart+ Ads through various endpoints:
Data Level The Endpoint to Use UI Screenshot Configuration Requirement Code Example
Ad level Option 1: /ad/get/ Use the ad_ids_v2 filter with IDs of Upgraded Smart+ Ads. See code examples below
Option 2: /smart_plus/ad/get/ N/A See code examples below
Option 3: /report/integrated/get/ or /report/task/create/ Set data_level to AUCTION_AD and include ad_id_v2 in dimensions.
Optionally, you can specify the IDs of certain Upgraded Smart+ Ads in the filter field ad_id_v2 to filter the reporting data for these ads.		 See code examples below
Creative level Option 1: /ad/get/ Do not use the ad_ids_v2 filter.
Optionally, you can specify the IDs of creatives within an Upgraded Smart+ Ad in the filter field ad_ids to filter the reporting data for these creatives.		 See code examples below
Option 2: /smart_plus/material_report/overview/ or /smart_plus/material_report/breakdown/ N/A See code examples below
Option 3: /report/integrated/get/ or /report/task/create/ Set data_level to AUCTION_AD and include ad_id in dimensions.
Optionally, you can specify the ID of a creative within an Upgraded Smart+ Ad in the filter field ad_id to filter the reporting data for the creative.		 See code examples below
### Example for retrieving ad level data through `/ad/get/` Request ```xcodeblock (code) curl --location --request GET 'https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/ad/get/?advertiser_id={{advertiser_id}}&filtering={"ad_ids_v2":["{{ad_id_v2}}"]}' \ --header 'Access-Token: {{Access-Token}}' (/code) ``` Response ```xcodeblock (code curl http) { "code": 0, "message": "OK", "request_id": "{{request_id}}", "data": { "list": [ { "campaign_id": "{{campaign_id}}", "adgroup_id": "{{adgroup_id}}", "campaign_name": "{{campaign_name}}", "ad_name": "{{ad_name}}", "ad_id_v2": "{{ad_id_v2}}", "advertiser_id": "{{advertiser_id}}", "campaign_automation_type": "UPGRADED_SMART_PLUS", "adgroup_name": "{{adgroup_name}}" } ], "page_info": { "page": 1, "page_size": 10, "total_page": 1, "total_number": 1 } } } (/code) ``` ### Example for retrieving ad level data through `/smart_plus/ad/get/` Request ```xcodeblock (code curl http) curl --location --request GET 'https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/smart_plus/ad/get/?advertiser_id={{advertiser_id}}&page=1&page_size=100&filtering={"smart_plus_ad_ids":["{{smart_plus_ad_id}}"]}' \ --header 'Access-Token: {{Access-Token}}' (/code) ``` Response ```xcodeblock (code curl http) { "code": 0, "message": "OK", "request_id": "{{request_id}}", "data": { "list": [ { "ad_configuration": { "call_to_action_id": "{{call_to_action_id}}", "catalog_creative_toggle": false, "fallback_type": "UNSET" }, "ad_name": "{{ad_name}}", "ad_text_list": [], "adgroup_id": "{{adgroup_id}}", "adgroup_name": "{{adgroup_name}}", "advertiser_id": "{{advertiser_id}}", "campaign_id": "{{campaign_id}}", "campaign_name": "{{campaign_name}}", "create_time": "{{create_time}}", "creative_list": [ { "ad_material_id": "{{ad_material_id}}", "creative_info": { "ad_format": "CAROUSEL_ADS", "identity_id": "{{identity_id}}", "identity_type": "AUTH_CODE", "tiktok_item_id": "{{tiktok_item_id}}" }, "material_operation_status": "ENABLE" } ], "deeplink_list": [], "landing_page_url_list": [ { "landing_page_url": "{{landing_page_url}}" } ], "modify_time": "{{modify_time}}", "operation_status": "ENABLE", "secondary_status": "AD_STATUS_CAMPAIGN_DISABLE", "smart_plus_ad_id": "{{smart_plus_ad_id}}" } ], "page_info": { "page": 1, "page_size": 100, "total_number": 1, "total_page": 1 } } } (/code) ``` ### Example for retrieving ad level data through `/report/integrated/get/` Request ```xcodeblock (code) curl --location --request GET 'https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/report/integrated/get/?advertiser_id={{advertiser_id}}&service_type=AUCTION&report_type=BASIC&data_level=AUCTION_AD&dimensions=["ad_id_v2"]&metrics=["spend","ad_id_v2","ad_name"]&filtering=[{"field_name": "ad_ids_v2","filter_type": "IN","filter_value": "[\"{{ad_id_v2}}\"]"}]&start_date={{start_date}}&end_date={{end_date}}&page=1&page_size=1000' \ --header 'Access-Token: {{Access-Token}}' (/code) ``` Response ```xcodeblock (code curl http) { "code": 0, "message": "OK", "request_id": "{{request_id}}", "data": { "page_info": { "page": 1, "total_page": 1, "page_size": 1, "total_number": 1 }, "list": [ { "dimensions": { "ad_id_v2": "{{ad_id_v2}}" }, "metrics": { "spend": "{{spend}}", "ad_id_v2": "{{ad_id_v2}}", "ad_name": "{{ad_name}}" } } ] } } (/code) ``` ### Example for retrieving creative level data through `/ad/get/` Request ```xcodeblock (code curl http) curl --location --request GET 'https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/ad/get/?advertiser_id={{advertiser_id}}&filtering={"ad_ids":["{{ad_id}}"]}' \ --header 'Access-Token: {{Access-Token}}' (/code) ``` Response ```xcodeblock (code curl http) { "code": 0, "message": "OK", "request_id": "{{request_id}}", "data": { "list": [ { "video_id": "{{video_id}}", "advertiser_id": "{{advertiser_id}}", "campaign_name": "{{campaign_name}}", "adgroup_name": "{{adgroup_name}}", "campaign_id": "{{campaign_id}}", "adgroup_id": "{{adgroup_id}}", "modify_time": "{{modify_time}}", "identity_id": "{{identity_id}}", "ad_id": "{{ad_id}}", "secondary_status": "AD_STATUS_CAMPAIGN_DISABLE", "identity_type": "CUSTOMIZED_USER", "campaign_automation_type": "UPGRADED_SMART_PLUS_CREATIVE", "ad_text": "", "smart_plus_ad_id": "{{smart_plus_ad_id}}", "operation_status": "ENABLE", "ad_name": "{{ad_name}}", "create_time": "{{create_time}}", "image_ids": [ "{{image_id}}" ] } ], "page_info": { "page": 1, "page_size": 10, "total_page": 1, "total_number": 1 } } } (/code) ``` ### Example for retrieving creative level data through `/smart_plus/material_report/overview/` Request ```xcodeblock (code curl http) curl --location --request GET 'https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/smart_plus/material_report/overview/?advertiser_id={{advertiser_id}}&dimensions=["smart_plus_ad_id","main_material_id"]&metrics=["spend"]&filtering={"smart_plus_ad_ids": ["{{smart_plus_ad_id}}"]}&start_date={{start_date}}&end_date={{end_date}}&page=1&page_size=100' \ --header 'Access-Token: {{Access-Token}}' (/code) ``` Response ```xcodeblock (code curl http) { "code": 0, "message": "OK", "request_id": "{{request_id}}", "data": { "list": [ { "dimensions": { "main_material_id": "{{main_material_id}}", "main_material_type": "VIDEO_SPARK_ADS", "smart_plus_ad_id": "{{smart_plus_ad_id}}" }, "metrics": { "main_material_name": "{{main_material_name}}", "spend": "0.00" } }, { "dimensions": { "main_material_id": "{{main_material_id}}", "main_material_type": "CAROUSEL_SPARK_ADS", "smart_plus_ad_id": "{{smart_plus_ad_id}}" }, "metrics": { "main_material_name": "{{main_material_name}}", "spend": "0.00" } } ], "page_info": { "page": 1, "page_size": 100, "total_number": 2, "total_page": 1 } } } (/code) ``` ### Example for retrieving creative level data through `/report/integrated/get/` Request ```xcodeblock (code) curl --location --request GET 'https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/report/integrated/get/?advertiser_id={{advertiser_id}}&service_type=AUCTION&report_type=BASIC&data_level=AUCTION_AD&dimensions=["ad_id"]&metrics=["spend","ad_id","ad_name"]&filtering=[{"field_name":"ad_ids","filter_type":"IN","filter_value":"[\"{{ad_id}}\"]"}]&start_date={{start_date}}&end_date={{end_date}}&page=1&page_size=1000' \ --header 'Access-Token: {{Access-Token}}' (/code) ``` Response ```xcodeblock (code curl http) { "code": 0, "message": "OK", "request_id": "{{request_id}}", "data": { "list": [ { "dimensions": { "ad_id": "{{ad_id}}" }, "metrics": { "spend": "{{spend}}", "ad_id": "{{ad_id}}", "ad_name": "{{ad_name}}" } } ], "page_info": { "page": 1, "total_number": 1, "page_size": 1, "total_page": 1 } } } (/code) ``` ## Q2: I attempted to update a campaign using both `/campaign/update/` and `/campaign/spc/update/`, but both endpoints returned the error: `This API does not support Upgraded Smart Plus ads.` What should I do? A: This issue may arise if you are trying to update an Upgraded Smart+ Campaign. To properly update such a campaign, you should use the endpoints [/smart_plus/campaign/update/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1843312876001282) or [/smart_plus/campaign/status/update/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1843312888885314). These endpoints are specifically designed to handle updates for Upgraded Smart+ Campaigns.
